messages:
maya-cs: forwarding customer report — Acadia Labs says their promo credit (TRIAL2026) landed in an old workspace instead of the new one. customer: erin@acadia.com. promo applied 2026-02-15. they can’t use credits on the new API keys. screenshots attached.
jake-billing: thanks — can you paste both org/workspace ids and any billing tx id? I’ll check the ledger.
maya-cs: org_old: org_89b, workspace_old: w-014; org_new: org_d4e, workspace_new: w-312. promo: TRIAL2026. promo amount: $200. billing tx id: 987654321. customer confirmed we can move credits.
olivia-se: quick question — how did duplicate workspace get created? SSO auto-provisioning or user-created?
maya-cs: customer says they manually created the new workspace after onboarding; old trial remained. no SSO. they used same email (erin@acadia.com) across both.
eng-oncall-bot: escalation created INC-20260215-87 — notifying eng-oncall.
simon-eng: I can migrate the credit balance from w-014 -> w-312. Need accounting sign-off and confirmation to zero old balance. plan: transactional update + backup. ETA after hours.
harper-finance: approved. prefer to move credits (preserve audit trail). approved transfer $200 with memo: "promo migration for Acadia Labs, ticket INC-20260215-87".
simon-eng: scheduling migration 2026-02-16 22:00 UTC. migration sql (run in a tx with row lock):
```sql
-- backup then update
INSERT INTO credit_backups (...) SELECT ... FROM credits WHERE workspace_id='w-014' AND promo_code='TRIAL2026';
UPDATE credits SET workspace_id='w-312', updated_at=now() WHERE workspace_id='w-014' AND promo_code='TRIAL2026';
```
I'll post pre/post ledger rows and logs.
jake-billing: after migration I’ll reconcile and mark promo as used for w-312. also can rotate API key in new workspace if customer asks.
maya-cs: told customer migration scheduled for 22:00 UTC. they replied thanks and asked for confirmation once done.
simon-eng: migration done at 2026-02-16 22:01 UTC. pre-migration: 1 row matched (w-014, promo TRIAL2026, balance 200). post-migration: workspace_id set to w-312. verification: w-312 balance shows $200, w-014 shows $0. ledger memo INC-20260215-87. logs: /var/log/migrations/credit_mig_20260216.log
harper-finance: verified reconciliation and ledger entries. closing accounting side.
maya-cs: confirmed with customer that credits now available on new workspace and they tested an API call — success. customer: "great, thank you". closing thread. :white_check_mark:
